newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: AIOC confirms first Azeri oil output by Aug 1997.
newsitem.headline: AIOC confirms first Azeri oil output by Aug 1997.

text.p: An international consortium developing three big oilfields offshore Azerbaijan confirmed on Wednesday that it will begin producing "early" oil on August 28, 1997, the Azeri presidential press service said.
A spokesman said Terry Adams, president of the Azerbaijan International Operating Co (AIOC), had informed Azeri President Haydar Aliyev of the production start-date.

AIOC groups Azeri state oil firm SOCAR, Amoco Corp, Pennzoil Co, Unocal Corp, Exxon Corp, British Petroleum, Ramco Energy Plc, Russia's LUKoil, Den Norske Stats Oljeselskap A/S (Statoil), the Turkish Petroleum Corp, McDermott International Inc, Itochu Corp and Saudi Arabia's Delta Nimir.
Early output from the consortium's Azeri, Chirag and Guneshli fields, in the Azeri sector of the Caspian Sea, is planned at 100,000 barrels per day (bpd), rising to 700,000-800,000 bpd by 2010.
